info: Prerequisite: Restricted to Sports Media majors.

sections.sectionText: Students who are planning to apply to transfer into Sports Media for Spring 2027 will not be able to register for MDIA 103 until they have been admitted into the major. There are NO exceptions. If spaces are still available in this course in January, newly admitted ICT transfers will be allowed to register after admission notifications are sent out.

subject: MDIA

info: Approved for letter and S/U grading. May be repeated in the same term to a maximum of 6 hours if topics vary; may be repeated in separate terms to a maximum of 12 hours if topics vary.

sections.sectionText: Informed Debate and the Modern University: This course aims to help students develop skills to engage in productive conversations and debates and to critically assess information in ways that should enhance their own campus experiences and prepare them to be informed and engaged citizens. It is a joint initiative between the College of Law and the College of Media. Meets with LAW 199.

sections.sectionText: In order to register for this course, students need to complete an Independent Study Form which can be found here: https://go.illinois.edu/GradIndependentStudy. Students must complete all sections of the form before it can be submitted for review by their participating instructor. Once the form has been reviewed and approved by the department, the student will receive further registration information via email from the College of Media Student Services Center.
